ticket.title: chalkline docs check counts test fixture literals as real CLI subcommands, so a repo without a CLI is told to document one
ticket.description: Reproduced 2026-11-06 while moving miter-inventory into common as gaugeblock-inventory (GB-204). 'chalkline docs check -d common' reported: [DRIFT] Readme - README missing documentation for CLI command 'scaffold'. common has no binary at all. The source of the string is gaugeblock-inventory/src/tests.rs, a clap fixture that writes 'pub enum Commands { Check {..}, Scaffold { path: String } }' into a TempDir: the repo-level clap extractor reads .rs text and treats the fixture as a declared subcommand. Moving the test file from src/ to tests/ did not help, so the scan is repo-wide, not source-dir-scoped. Workaround applied: the fixture now lives in src/fixtures/cli_enum.txt and is loaded with include_str!, so the scan cannot see it; the assertion is unchanged.\n\nRoot cause is the same class as GB-199, where miter deps counted test fixture strings as real crate references and the fix was to strip literals and comments before scanning. The clap extractor needs the same treatment; every crate whose tests embed a clap sample will otherwise demand documentation for a command it does not have.
